detail.title: What happens behind the tile
detail.text: Most bathroom failures start where nobody looks: the shower pan, the corners and the valve penetrations. We detail those first and inspect them before any tile goes up.

items.q: Can you move the toilet or shower?
items.a: Usually, yes. Moving drains depends on the floor structure and access below. We check this at the walkthrough.
Most remodels that change plumbing, electrical or walls need permits in Los Angeles. We pull them and schedule inspections.

items.q: Can I use my home during a bathroom remodel?
items.a: Yes, if you have another bathroom. We keep the work area closed off and clean the site each day.
After the walkthrough and design, you get a written scope and price, with named allowances for tile and fixtures and a written exclusions page.
